notes.title: Recent Demo Updates
notes.content: [p][b]Recent Demo Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Spike Collision Rewind[/b]: Players now revert to the last standing platform upon hitting spikes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Foreground Layer Optimization[/b]: Continuous daily enhancements to foreground layers since Demo launch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Controller Support[/b]: Complete compatibility with game controllers.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upcoming Demo Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Easy Mode[/b]: Allows casual players to experience the full game flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Corpse Drop[/b]: Corpses remain after defeating minor enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Key Customization[/b]: Customizable button mappings for controls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Function[/b]: Save game progress at any point.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Action Smoothness[/b]: Ongoing optimization planned for the next year.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Foreground Spikes[/b]: Some spikes are currently obscured by foreground elements. Removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Bullet Overload Bug[/b]: Already fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo released
notes.content: [p]‌[b]Demo Content Introduction[/b]‌[/p][list][*][p]The demo primarily focuses on one major theme (the garden), while the full version of the game will feature over a dozen themes.‌[/p][/*][*][p]Progress cannot be saved in the demo, so please complete your exploration before exiting. (It includes 3 bosses and 3 amulets.)‌[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The demo does not represent the final quality of the game. Development is expected to continue for another year, with many areas requiring refinement.‌[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo will be released around Sep.1st
